quick_skim.title: Learning Dynamical Systems from Multiple Sparse Datasets: A Hierarchical Bayesian Modeling Approach
quick_skim.abstract: Estimating parameters of dynamical systems from sparse, noisy, and irregularly sampled data is often severely ill-conditioned. When multiple related datasets are available, they provide additional information if the shared structure and variability are properly modeled. We propose a hierarchical Bayesian framework for probabilistic meta-learning in dynamical systems, modeling dataset-specific parameters as draws from a shared population distribution. A numerical ODE solver is embedded within gradient-based MCMC to enable efficient posterior inference of the shared population and dataset-specific parameter distribution. Experiments show improved predictive performance over unpooled methods, highlighting the potential for data-efficient system identification in settings with sparse data.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 从多个稀疏、不规则采样的数据集学习动力系统参数是病态的。本文提出层次贝叶斯框架，将数据集特定参数建模为来自共享总体分布的样本，并嵌入ODE求解器与梯度MCMC进行后验推断。实验表明，该方法比独立学习每个数据集具有更好的预测性能，展示了贝叶斯元学习的潜力。
